==Overview==
'''The Champions''' takes place in Seoul, South Korea starting in March 2012 and ending in May 2012. This is OnGameNet's first major tournament after the [[OnGameNet LoL Invitational]]. The tournament is aired on OnGameNet's Korean channel as well as an online English stream. [[Azubu The Champions Spring 2012|The Champions Spring]] along with [[Azubu The Champions Summer 2012|The Champions Summer]], [[NLB Spring 2012]], [[NLB Summer 2012]] will award Circuit Points to determine two Korean teams to participate in the [[Season 2 World Championship]].<ref>[http://www.thisisgame.com/board/view.php?id=1176993&category=102 30억짜리 LOL 세계대회, 관건은 ‘서킷 포인트’]''"thisisgame.com"''</ref>

===Format===
*Qualifiers are twelve groups of two.
**Each match is Best of Three - Top One team from each group advance.
*Round of 16 Group Stage is four groups of four.
**Each match is Best of One - Top Two teams from each group advance.
*The remaining eight teams are put into an elimination bracket.
**The quarterfinals and the Third-Fourth place match are Best of Three, while the Semifinals and Finals are Best of Five.
*In all Best of Threes and Best of Fives, the final game is Blind Pick while other games are Draft Pick.

*Final placing determines results for seeding into the [[Azubu The Champions Summer 2012]].
**An online tournament was played at the same time as The Champions, with the winner playing versus the Fourth Place team for seeding points
